t_power.instructions: Power. Main appliance power only; not the switch for an individual feature.

t_work_mode.instructions: Mode. Main operating mode. Auto mode is different from Comfort Auto.

t_temp.instructions: Temperature (Celsius). Celsius setpoint only. A Celsius temperature requires t_temp_type=0 too.

t_temp_f.instructions: Temperature (Fahrenheit). Fahrenheit setpoint only. A Fahrenheit temperature requires t_temp_type=1 too. Do not convert to Celsius.

t_temp_type.instructions: Temperature Unit. Required companion of a temperature setting: Celsius=0, Fahrenheit=1.

t_fan_speed.instructions: Fan Speed. Fan speed. Turbo/Super is a separate function, not a fan speed.

t_fan_mute.instructions: Quiet. Indoor unit quiet only; different from outdoor quiet.

t_super.instructions: Super Mode. Super/Turbo/powerful/rapid cooling or heating function; separate from fan speed.

t_up_down.instructions: Up and Down Swing. Continuous up-and-down swing switch; fixed vertical positions use t_swing_angle.

t_indoortemp_detection.instructions: Comfort Auto. Comfort Auto based on indoor temperature detection; different from Auto operating mode.

t_left_right.instructions: Left and Right Swing. Basic left-and-right swing switch; specific horizontal directions use t_swing_direction.

t_swing_angle.instructions: Airflow. Vertical airflow position. Use the option value, not the position number in its label.

t_swing_direction.instructions: Horizontal Airflow. Horizontal airflow direction. Splayed/both-sides airflow is value 2.

t_eco.instructions: Energy Saving. Energy saving/Eco function; not an operating mode value.

t_purify.instructions: Air Purification. Air purification; different from the LED display/Dimmer.

t_swing_follow.instructions: AI Wind. AI Wind human-sensing airflow; different from AI Smart/TMS.

t_8heat.instructions: 8° Heat. 8-degree Celsius frost-protection heating; different from Heat operating mode.

t_dimmer.instructions: Dimmer. LED display/panel light; different from air purification. Off=0, On=1.

t_indoor_selfclean.instructions: Indoor Self-Clean. Clean only the indoor unit.

t_outdoor_selfclean.instructions: Outdoor Self-Clean. Clean only the outdoor unit.

t_onekey_selfclean.instructions: One-Key Self-Clean. Combined one-key indoor/outdoor self-clean function.

t_fresh_air.instructions: Fresh Air. Fresh air/ventilation function; different from Healthy Wind.

t_tms.instructions: AI Smart Control. General AI Smart/TMS function; different from AI Wind.

t_health_fan.instructions: Healthy Wind. Healthy Wind function; different from Fresh Air.

t_outdoor_mute.instructions: Outdoor Quiet. Outdoor unit quiet only; different from indoor Quiet.

t_dr_onoff.instructions: DR On/Off. Demand Response main switch.

t_dr_offset.instructions: DR Offset Temperature. Demand Response temperature offset.

t_dr_mode.instructions: DR Load Capacity. Demand Response load/capacity percentage.

t_auto_defrost_clean.instructions: Auto-Defrost Clean. Only values 0 and 1 are user-controllable. Values 2, 3 and 4 describe running status and must never be commanded.
